# Second-quarter and half-year results 2026

Aker Solutions delivered solid financial performance in the second quarter and the first half of
2026. Several key project milestones were met during the quarter. Aker Solutions now expects 2026
revenue to be between NOK 50 and 55 billion with EBITDA margins of around 7.5 percent excluding net
profit from SLB OneSubsea.
[Read more][2]

# Aker Solutions secures contract with Tussa Energi for Tussa II hydropower plant

Aker Solutions has secured a sizeable[1] contract with Tussa Energi to supply all electromechanical
equipment for the Tussa II hydropower plant, located in the Volda region of western Norway.
[Read more][3]

# Aker Solutions awarded Engineering and Maintenance Service agreement from Cenovus Energy

Aker Solutions has signed a sizeable¹ five-year agreement with Cenovus Energy Inc. for engineering
and maintenance services on White Rose field assets. 
[Read more][4]

# Aker Solutions wins FEED-contract for Equinor’s Atlantis tie-in

Aker Solutions has been awarded a front-end engineering and design (FEED) contract by Equinor to
prepare the Kvitebjørn platform for production from the Atlantis subsea tie-in project.
[Read more][5]

# First-quarter results 2026

Aker Solutions has delivered solid financial results as revenues normalize from peak levels in 2025.
The company recorded an order intake in the first quarter of NOK 28.8 billion, lifting the secured
order backlog to NOK 80.2 billion at quarter-end. Revenue in 2026 is expected to be around NOK 50
billion with EBITDA-margins excluding net income from SLB OneSubsea in the range of 7.0 to 7.5
percent. In April, the Annual General Meeting approved the total distribution of NOK 8.60 per share
in ordinary and extraordinary dividends, which was paid to shareholders on April 27, 2026.
[Read more][6]

# Aker Solutions signs MOU with Rolls-Royce SMR for small modular reactor energy projects

Aker Solutions AS has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Rolls-Royce SMR Ltd within the
small modular reactor (SMR) market. The MoU establishes a partnership to develop Aker Solutions’
offering of non-nuclear parts of framed modules for Rolls-Royce SMR’s portfolio, leveraging Aker
Solutions’ deep expertise in modularization and complex energy project execution.
[Read more][7]
[picture of aker solution logo on a wall]

# Aker Solutions wins FEED contract for CO₂ terminal in Lithuania

Aker Solutions has been awarded a front-end engineering and design (FEED) contract by KN Energies to
support the development of the company’s CO₂ transshipment terminal infrastructure project in
Klaipėda, Lithuania.
[Read about the Klaipėda CO2 terminal][8]

# Aker Solutions awarded long-term MMO frame agreement by Aker BP

Aker Solutions has been awarded a major[1] five-year contract with Aker BP for Maintenance,
Modification and Operation services (MMO). The contract covers all Aker BP’s key assets on the
Norwegian Continental Shelf, including the new Yggdrasil area.
[Read more][9]
[Photo of Aker BP's Valhall platform ]

# Fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results

Aker Solutions delivered solid financial results in a period of record-high activity and intends to
pay out dividends of NOK 3.60 per share for 2025.
[Read more][10]

# Aker Solutions secures long-term maintenance and modifications frame agreements with Equinor

Aker Solutions has been awarded multiple five-year frame agreements with Equinor. Under the
agreements, Aker Solutions will provide maintenance and modifications services for a range of assets
on the Norwegian Continental Shelf (NCS) and onshore Norway.
[Read more][11]

# Aker Solutions awarded substantial M&M contract by ConocoPhillips

Aker Solutions has signed a six-year frame agreement with ConocoPhillips Skandinavia AS
(ConocoPhillips), which includes an option to extend the contract for up to two additional
three-year periods. 
[Read more][12]
[picture of Aker Solution workers on Ekofisk]

# Aker Solutions secures significant brownfield services contract from ExxonMobil Canada

Aker Solutions has signed a five-year enabling contract with ExxonMobil Canada Properties, a
partnership, as operator of the Hebron platform. The contract is an extension for brownfield
maintenance and modification (M&M) services on the Hebron platform.
[Read more][13]
[picture of aker solution logo on a wall]

# Second-quarter and half-year results 2026

Aker Solutions delivered solid financial performance in the second quarter and the first half of
2026. Several key project milestones were met during the quarter. Aker Solutions now expects 2026
revenue to be between NOK 50 and 55 billion with EBITDA margins of around 7.5 percent excluding net
profit from SLB OneSubsea.
[Read more][2]

# Aker Solutions secures contract with Tussa Energi for Tussa II hydropower plant

Aker Solutions has secured a sizeable[1] contract with Tussa Energi to supply all electromechanical
equipment for the Tussa II hydropower plant, located in the Volda region of western Norway.
[Read more][3]

# Aker Solutions awarded Engineering and Maintenance Service agreement from Cenovus Energy

Aker Solutions has signed a sizeable¹ five-year agreement with Cenovus Energy Inc. for engineering
and maintenance services on White Rose field assets. 
[Read more][4]

# Aker Solutions wins FEED-contract for Equinor’s Atlantis tie-in

Aker Solutions has been awarded a front-end engineering and design (FEED) contract by Equinor to
prepare the Kvitebjørn platform for production from the Atlantis subsea tie-in project.
[Read more][5]

# First-quarter results 2026

Aker Solutions has delivered solid financial results as revenues normalize from peak levels in 2025.
The company recorded an order intake in the first quarter of NOK 28.8 billion, lifting the secured
order backlog to NOK 80.2 billion at quarter-end. Revenue in 2026 is expected to be around NOK 50
billion with EBITDA-margins excluding net income from SLB OneSubsea in the range of 7.0 to 7.5
percent. In April, the Annual General Meeting approved the total distribution of NOK 8.60 per share
in ordinary and extraordinary dividends, which was paid to shareholders on April 27, 2026.
[Read more][6]

# Aker Solutions signs MOU with Rolls-Royce SMR for small modular reactor energy projects

Aker Solutions AS has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Rolls-Royce SMR Ltd within the
small modular reactor (SMR) market. The MoU establishes a partnership to develop Aker Solutions’
offering of non-nuclear parts of framed modules for Rolls-Royce SMR’s portfolio, leveraging Aker
Solutions’ deep expertise in modularization and complex energy project execution.
[Read more][7]
[picture of aker solution logo on a wall]

# Aker Solutions wins FEED contract for CO₂ terminal in Lithuania

Aker Solutions has been awarded a front-end engineering and design (FEED) contract by KN Energies to
support the development of the company’s CO₂ transshipment terminal infrastructure project in
Klaipėda, Lithuania.
[Read about the Klaipėda CO2 terminal][8]

# Aker Solutions awarded long-term MMO frame agreement by Aker BP

Aker Solutions has been awarded a major[1] five-year contract with Aker BP for Maintenance,
Modification and Operation services (MMO). The contract covers all Aker BP’s key assets on the
Norwegian Continental Shelf, including the new Yggdrasil area.
[Read more][9]
[Photo of Aker BP's Valhall platform ]

# Fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results

Aker Solutions delivered solid financial results in a period of record-high activity and intends to
pay out dividends of NOK 3.60 per share for 2025.
[Read more][10]

# Aker Solutions secures long-term maintenance and modifications frame agreements with Equinor

Aker Solutions has been awarded multiple five-year frame agreements with Equinor. Under the
agreements, Aker Solutions will provide maintenance and modifications services for a range of assets
on the Norwegian Continental Shelf (NCS) and onshore Norway.
[Read more][11]

# Aker Solutions awarded substantial M&M contract by ConocoPhillips

Aker Solutions has signed a six-year frame agreement with ConocoPhillips Skandinavia AS
(ConocoPhillips), which includes an option to extend the contract for up to two additional
three-year periods. 
[Read more][12]
[picture of Aker Solution workers on Ekofisk]

# Aker Solutions secures significant brownfield services contract from ExxonMobil Canada

Aker Solutions has signed a five-year enabling contract with ExxonMobil Canada Properties, a
partnership, as operator of the Hebron platform. The contract is an extension for brownfield
maintenance and modification (M&M) services on the Hebron platform.
[Read more][13]
[picture of aker solution logo on a wall]

###### About Us



## *Petroleum history provides context for understanding modern energy challenges.*

****

The American Oil & Gas Historical Society (AOGHS) preserves U.S. petroleum history, which provides a
critical context for understanding the energy industry. This history, which began in August 1859
with the [first commercial U.S. well][39] in Titusville, Pennsylvania, can help us make informed
decisions about meeting future energy needs. AOGHS offers education resources, including links to
community [oil and gas museums][40], county historical societies, libraries, and others dedicated to
material preservation. Please [support][41] our effort.

## About Us

### CHINA KOMAL INTERNATIONAL CO., LTD

CHINA KOMAL INTERNATIONAL CO., LTD is a professional international enterprise specializing in the
R&D, manufacturing and sales of oilfield equipment. Established in 2010, the company is
headquartered in Beijing and owns a modern production base and a comprehensive sales network.

Main products include: petroleum equipment, solids control systems, mud pump parts, shaker screens,
and high pressure pumps. Our products are widely used in the fields of oil and natural gas
exploration and development, and are exported to the Middle East, North America, South America,
Southeast Asia and other regions, highly trusted by customers worldwide.

[Contact Us][11]

## [Foresight Private Equity][63]

[Foresight Private Equity partners with businesses across global market to build enduring
enterprises through disciplined capital allocation and deep operational expertise.][64]

[We invest in high-quality businesses and real-economic assets with strong growth potential, working
closely with management teams to create long-term sustainable value. Our approach combines strategic
partnerships, operational excellence, and access to global networks to drive performance across
cycles.][65]

[In line with our commitment to innovation and future growth, Foresight Private Equity collaborates
with the MIT Industrial Liaison Program (USA) on emerging opportunities and engages with the MIT
Startup Exchange to identify and invest in transformative technologies—building the next generation
of growth engines for the future.][66]

## Foresight Capital

Foresight Capital is the Group’s central capital and treasury platform, actively managing global
money markets and financial instruments with discipline, precision and strategic intent.

It drives capital allocation, risk management, and liquidity strength while operating as a strategic
profit centre – generating consistent returns and reinforcing long-term financial resilience.

Core Mandate:
* Capital allocation with discipline
* Active treasury & global market management
* Liquidity strength
* Consistent return generation.

## Foresight Business Park

Foresight Business Park brings together the Group’s commercial real estate platform across London,
UK and Mumbai, India, anchored by Foresight House in the City of London – the Group’s original base
since 1984 and headquarters until 2016 – mow retained to house the Founder Chairman’s office
alongside a curated leasing platform and ASM House in Mumbai, the Group’s Global Capability Centre.

The platform is expanding with a 250,000 sq ft institutional-grade business park in Santacruz,
Mumbai (scheduled to completed by 2034) designed to create high-quality, future-ready commercial
environments.

It delivers stable income, long-term asset value and enduring balance sheet strength, reflecting a
disciplined approach to building real estate platforms for the long term.

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

drilling deviations, high maintenance frequency, and excessive energy consumption. Coupled with the
current upgrades to green mining construction standards and plans to expand mining capacity, the
existing equipment's capacity could not match monthly mining targets. Equipment repairs, downtime,
and high maintenance costs continued to drive up operating costs. Therefore, they planned to replace
their existing rigs with high-efficiency, energy-saving open-pit drilling rigs.

# WELCOME TO **NOIA**

The National Ocean Industries Association – NOIA – serves the offshore oil, gas, wind and ocean
minerals industries and provides tremendous value to its members by uniting and advancing the
business and professional interests of its members and the industry.

### **NOIA** Mission

NOIA represents and advances a dynamic and growing offshore energy industry, providing solutions
that support communities and protect our workers, the public and our environment.

### **NOIA** Vision

NOIA is the sought-after and credible voice, advocate and forum for uniting and advancing the
interests of the offshore energy industry, recognized for promoting solutions that provide the
energy vital for lifting society in a safe and environmentally sustainable way.

## **NOIA** Objectives
* To promote the common interests of the members of the offshore energy industry.
* To facilitate a meaningful energy dialogue from diverse perspectives.
* To promote the role of a competitive, fair and free market in the development of offshore energy
  resources.
* To influence public policy in support of the offshore energy industry.
* To be a learning organization and foster the mutual improvement of its members, including safety
  and environmental performance, through collaborative industry programs and efforts.
* To educate the public and policy makers with scientifically grounded information about the
  industry and its impact on our everyday lives.
* We strive to contribute solutions and best practices to optimally balance societal and
  environmental needs for meeting the climate challenge.
* To serve as a resource for the government and other stakeholders.

Onshore Oil and Gas companies with a clear objective to offer a comprehensive and cost-effective

for all related requirements.

# Experts in Innovative Testing

OTC GreenLight, a Digital Pressure Testing (DPT) software suite, is designed to efficiently conduct,
analyze and predict the outcome of a variety of pressure tests, not just those limited to BOPs. The
new and improved [GreenLight][46] is the only system to achieve [DNV RP A203 Technical
Qualification][47] and sets a new standard for digital pressure testing of [Well Control
Systems][48]. Derived from the first digital system in the industry, it’s the best pressure testing
technology providing superior test planning and optimization, analysis, documentation, leak
detection and compliance support. All of this in less than half the time of traditional circle chart
recording methods. It features software that allows maximum efficiency for our clients and their
operations. Tests are recorded in a secure, binary file format. This format is proprietary – only
tools specifically written by the OTC GreenLight team can read the file format. There are other
tools also included in the [GreenLight Suite.][49]

[][50]

The only DPT Assurance software suite with a DNV certification mark, **GreenLight** is designed to
efficiently conduct, analyze, and predict the outcome of a variety of pressure tests.

**Blueprint** is a stand-alone software solution used to plan tests of the choke manifold and

## [Offshore Technical Compliance and ModuSpec enter into R&D agreement to advance well control
## assurance][58]

Offshore Technical Compliance LLC (OTC), a leader in delivering regulatory compliance services and
digital technology solutions to the global oil and gas industry, has entered into a research and
development (R&D) agreement with global rig and well control equipment solutions specialists
ModuSpec, to deliver a streamlined approach to well control system assurance.

Originally established in 2022, the strategic alliance between OTC Greenlight and ModuSpec continues
to evolve, with both companies maintaining their independence as experts in real-time monitoring
(RTM) and digital pressure testing (DPT) respectively.

OTC Greenlight’s DNV-qualified DPT platform has transformed well control verification, reducing test
time by up to 50% while delivering accurate, auditable results. Complementing this, ModuSpec’s RTM
services provide continuous insight into subsea and BOP system performance, enabling predictive
maintenance and rapid issue resolution through advanced analytics.

Together, OTC Greenlight and ModuSpec offer a cohesive, simplified solution for well control
assurance. Operators benefit from integrated data intelligence, streamlined workflows, and reduced
non-productive time without the complexity of managing multiple vendors. The result is a unified,
future-ready operational model that supports confident decision-making and long-term asset
integrity, even in the most challenging offshore environments.

The partnership has now been extended alongside a new R&D agreement aimed at enhancing the combined
RTM and DPT offering and further advancing ModuSpec’s RTM capabilities. The collaboration is set to
deliver smarter, more integrated solutions that enhance safety and drive efficiency, reliability,
and regulatory compliance across global offshore operations.

Mike Bethea, CEO of OTC, said, “This renewed partnership between OTC and ModuSpec reinforces our
shared commitment to innovation in well control assurance. OTC’s considerable talents in digital
solutions and AI combined with ModuSpec’s experience in well control assurance can now be fully
leveraged to the benefit of our customers. I expect the combined R&D effort to yield industry
leading innovation at an unmatched pace.”

Duco de Haan, CEO of MR Group – ModuSpec’s parent company – said, “Incorporating an R&D element into
our agreement with OTC is a truly exciting development for all involved. Not only will this enable
us to further enhance the unified solutions we bring to our clients, but we can leverage the
considerable academic expertise in mathematics and AI of the OTC team combined with our own in-house
technical experience to ensure we remain at the forefront of developments in the RTM arena.”

## Kenneth D. St. Pé, APLC

**Compassionate Advocacy. Proven Results.**

At Kenneth D. St. Pé, APLC, we understand that no amount of compensation can undo the pain your
family has endured — but justice can bring peace, closure, and accountability. Our mission is to
help you achieve these.

For more than two decades, our firm has represented families across Louisiana in complex nursing
home neglect and medical malpractice cases, recovering **millions of dollars** for victims and their
loved ones. Every case we take begins with a **thorough investigation**, driven by compassion and an
unwavering pursuit of truth. We dig deep to uncover what really happened — and make sure those
responsible are held accountable.

You won’t be handed off to a case manager or left waiting for updates. When you work with us, you
get **direct access to attorney Kenneth D. St. Pé**, who will personally guide you through every
step of the process. Clients appreciate our **clear communication**, **relentless advocacy**, and
**commitment to treating every family with dignity and respect.**

When you place your trust in us, you can expect compassion, transparency, and proven results — from
a team that genuinely cares about your family’s healing and your right to justice.

## The Benefits of Working With Kenneth D. St. Pé, APLC

[icon2]

Knowing someone trustworthy is fighting for you
You can finally stop worrying about what’s next. Our firm handles every detail — from the
investigation to the courtroom — so you can focus on your family’s healing. We keep you informed and
empowered.

[icon2]

### Financial Security

Compensation that helps rebuild your future
Justice includes holding negligent parties accountable — but it also means securing the resources
you need to move forward. We’ve recovered **millions of dollars** for clients statewide, helping
families cover medical costs and future care.

Direct, compassionate communication

or distant associate. We take the time to listen, to answer your questions, and to treat your

## *Petroleum history provides context for understanding modern energy challenges.*

****

The American Oil & Gas Historical Society (AOGHS) preserves U.S. petroleum history, which provides a
critical context for understanding the energy industry. This history, which began in August 1859
with the [first commercial U.S. well][39] in Titusville, Pennsylvania, can help us make informed
decisions about meeting future energy needs. AOGHS offers education resources, including links to
community [oil and gas museums][40], county historical societies, libraries, and others dedicated to
material preservation. Please [support][41] our effort.

## Foresight Business Park

Foresight Business Park brings together the Group’s commercial real estate platform across London,
UK and Mumbai, India, anchored by Foresight House in the City of London – the Group’s original base
since 1984 and headquarters until 2016 – mow retained to house the Founder Chairman’s office

environments.

disciplined approach to building real estate platforms for the long term.

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

minerals industries and provides tremendous value to its members by uniting and advancing the

interests of the offshore energy industry, recognized for promoting solutions that provide the

* To promote the common interests of the members of the offshore energy industry.
* To facilitate a meaningful energy dialogue from diverse perspectives.
* To promote the role of a competitive, fair and free market in the development of offshore energy
  resources.
* To influence public policy in support of the offshore energy industry.
* To be a learning organization and foster the mutual improvement of its members, including safety
  and environmental performance, through collaborative industry programs and efforts.
* To educate the public and policy makers with scientifically grounded information about the
  industry and its impact on our everyday lives.
* We strive to contribute solutions and best practices to optimally balance societal and
  environmental needs for meeting the climate challenge.
* To serve as a resource for the government and other stakeholders.

analyze and predict the outcome of a variety of pressure tests, not just those limited to BOPs. The

## [Offshore Technical Compliance and ModuSpec enter into R&D agreement to advance well control
## assurance][58]

Offshore Technical Compliance LLC (OTC), a leader in delivering regulatory compliance services and
digital technology solutions to the global oil and gas industry, has entered into a research and
development (R&D) agreement with global rig and well control equipment solutions specialists
ModuSpec, to deliver a streamlined approach to well control system assurance.

Originally established in 2022, the strategic alliance between OTC Greenlight and ModuSpec continues
to evolve, with both companies maintaining their independence as experts in real-time monitoring
(RTM) and digital pressure testing (DPT) respectively.

OTC Greenlight’s DNV-qualified DPT platform has transformed well control verification, reducing test
time by up to 50% while delivering accurate, auditable results. Complementing this, ModuSpec’s RTM
services provide continuous insight into subsea and BOP system performance, enabling predictive
maintenance and rapid issue resolution through advanced analytics.

Together, OTC Greenlight and ModuSpec offer a cohesive, simplified solution for well control
assurance. Operators benefit from integrated data intelligence, streamlined workflows, and reduced
non-productive time without the complexity of managing multiple vendors. The result is a unified,
future-ready operational model that supports confident decision-making and long-term asset
integrity, even in the most challenging offshore environments.

The partnership has now been extended alongside a new R&D agreement aimed at enhancing the combined
RTM and DPT offering and further advancing ModuSpec’s RTM capabilities. The collaboration is set to
deliver smarter, more integrated solutions that enhance safety and drive efficiency, reliability,
and regulatory compliance across global offshore operations.

Mike Bethea, CEO of OTC, said, “This renewed partnership between OTC and ModuSpec reinforces our
shared commitment to innovation in well control assurance. OTC’s considerable talents in digital
solutions and AI combined with ModuSpec’s experience in well control assurance can now be fully
leveraged to the benefit of our customers. I expect the combined R&D effort to yield industry
leading innovation at an unmatched pace.”

Duco de Haan, CEO of MR Group – ModuSpec’s parent company – said, “Incorporating an R&D element into
our agreement with OTC is a truly exciting development for all involved. Not only will this enable
us to further enhance the unified solutions we bring to our clients, but we can leverage the
considerable academic expertise in mathematics and AI of the OTC team combined with our own in-house
technical experience to ensure we remain at the forefront of developments in the RTM arena.”

## Kenneth D. St. Pé, APLC

**Compassionate Advocacy. Proven Results.**

At Kenneth D. St. Pé, APLC, we understand that no amount of compensation can undo the pain your
family has endured — but justice can bring peace, closure, and accountability. Our mission is to
help you achieve these.

For more than two decades, our firm has represented families across Louisiana in complex nursing
home neglect and medical malpractice cases, recovering **millions of dollars** for victims and their
loved ones. Every case we take begins with a **thorough investigation**, driven by compassion and an
unwavering pursuit of truth. We dig deep to uncover what really happened — and make sure those
responsible are held accountable.

You won’t be handed off to a case manager or left waiting for updates. When you work with us, you
get **direct access to attorney Kenneth D. St. Pé**, who will personally guide you through every
step of the process. Clients appreciate our **clear communication**, **relentless advocacy**, and
**commitment to treating every family with dignity and respect.**

When you place your trust in us, you can expect compassion, transparency, and proven results — from
a team that genuinely cares about your family’s healing and your right to justice.

## The Benefits of Working With Kenneth D. St. Pé, APLC

[icon2]

### Peace of Mind

Knowing someone trustworthy is fighting for you
You can finally stop worrying about what’s next. Our firm handles every detail — from the
investigation to the courtroom — so you can focus on your family’s healing. We keep you informed and
empowered.

[icon2]

### Financial Security

Compensation that helps rebuild your future
Justice includes holding negligent parties accountable — but it also means securing the resources
you need to move forward. We’ve recovered **millions of dollars** for clients statewide, helping
families cover medical costs and future care.

[icon3]

### Personal Attention

Direct, compassionate communication
You’ll work directly with attorney **Kenneth D. St. Pé **every step of the way, not a case manager
or distant associate. We take the time to listen, to answer your questions, and to treat your
family’s story with the care and respect it deserves.
